Hi team,

We have the leadership packet review on Tuesday (6/22) and I want to lock the commit list and tighten forecast ranges by COB Monday. Goals are:
- Reduce the uncertain commit dollar range by reconciling A/B opportunities and confirming buying timelines.
- Surface any stage regressions (late-stage stalls) and add short remediation notes for leadership.
- Assemble a one-page snapshot per commit for the exec packet (deal summary, ask, risk, next-step).

I've attached a working commit matrix (commit_matrix_live.xlsx) and a rough exec packet draft (Q2_exec_packet_draft.pdf). Please:
1) Karthik — run through the B- and C-risked deals and call out any that should be removed from commit.
2) Grace — prep the one-page snapshots for the top 6 commits and flag any required CS or legal support.
3) Everyone — update the stage on the matrix (Commit/Commit-At-Risk/Commit-Remove) and add a single-line reason.

Iâ€™ll do a 30-min dry-run at 3pm on Monday to validate the pack. If you canâ€™t make that slot, please add a comment in the Drive link with your edits.

Thanks,
Jordan

Thanks Jordan — got it. Quick notes after a run through:

- BlueOrbit (HD-4492): sales exec confirms renewed interest but procurement timeline slipped to late July; recommend move to Commit-At-Risk and tighten upside to $120k (was $180k).
- ACME (long-standing): legal has a new redline re: data residency; we should add Legal and Security to the one-pager. Procurement contact copied below for visibility.
- Two mid-stage logos (small ARR) are still being chased by SDR — they should be removed from commit unless AE confirms intent by Monday morning.

I updated the commit_matrix_live.xlsx with inline notes and color-coded stage cells (green/yellow/red). I also added a short 'migration risk' column for models requiring on-prem/private.

I can handle the B- and C-risked list and will propose a trimmed commit list by 1pm.

Karthik
